constraints: Invoke the capability through `bash skills/og-quality-pass/scripts/run_quality_pass.sh` from repo-root context; the script also accepts an optional first argument to override the target repo root.
Use only repo-local executables under `.venv/bin` for `ruff`, `ty`, and `pytest`.
Require `og.py` and `tests/` at the selected repo root before any checks run.
Preserve the exact execution order `ruff check og.py tests`, then `ty check --output-format concise`, then `pytest -q`.
Run all three checks even if an earlier check fails, then aggregate the final status.
Return exit code 2 for missing tools or invalid repository layout, exit code 1 for any failed check, and exit code 0 only when all checks succeed.
Failure reporting should retain the step label, echoed `CMD:` line, and first actionable error lines from the failing tool output.
goal: Run a deterministic local OutcomeGraph quality gate through the bundled wrapper script so `ruff`, `ty`, and `pytest` execute in one pass and collapse to a single pass/fail outcome.
